instruction: How much money have I sent to my roommates on venmo since 1st Jan of this year?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, so the goal only demands that the answer (total sent amount) has been computed and the task completed. Roommates are not known up front, so a single representative person object `roommate` stands for the set returned by phone.search_contacts(query='roommates', relationship='roommates'); at runtime venmo.show_transactions(user_email=<contact email>, min_created_at='<year>-01-01', direction='sent') is repeated for every roommate contact and paginated, and the amounts are summed into amount-total-sent. Usernames come from supervisor.show_profile (phone_number for phone, email for venmo), passwords from supervisor.show_account_passwords; phone.get_current_date_and_time is required before show_transactions to fix the current year for the 1 Jan threshold. supervisor-complete-task passes the total as `answer` and is forced last via (task-completed).

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'datetime', 'query', 'token', 'password', 'relationship', 'person', 'amount', 'direction', 'username', 'app', 'email'}

plan: (venmo-show-transactions venmo-token roommate-email date-2023-01-01 direction-sent roommate amount-total-sent)
